verses.1:1: And the Lord called Moses and spoke to him from the tent of testimony, saying,
verses.1:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'If any man among you brings gifts to the Lord, from the livestock, and from the herds, and from the flocks you shall bring your gifts.
verses.1:3: If his gift is a whole burnt offering from the herds, he shall bring a male without blemish; to the door of the tent of testimony he shall bring it, acceptable for him before the Lord.
verses.1:4: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the offering, acceptable for him to make atonement for him.
verses.1:5: And they shall slay the calf before the Lord; and the priests, the sons of Aaron, shall bring the blood and pour the blood upon the altar all around, which is at the doors of the tent of testimony.
verses.1:6: And having skinned the whole burnt offering, they shall cut it into its pieces.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall put fire upon the altar and pile wood upon the fire.
verses.1:8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pile the cut pieces, and the head, and the fat upon the wood that is on the fire, which is upon the altar;
verses.1:9: but its entrails and the feet they shall wash with water; and the priests shall place all of them upon the altar. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.1:10: Now if his gift to the Lord is from the flocks, both from the lambs and from the kids, for a whole burnt offering, he shall bring it, a male without blemish,
verses.1:11: and he shall lay his hand upon its head. And they shall slay it at the side of the altar toward the north, before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour its blood upon the altar all around.
verses.1:12: And they shall divide it into its pieces, together with the head and the fat; and the priests shall pile them upon the wood that is on the fire, which is upon the altar;
verses.1:13: and the entrails and the feet they shall wash with water. And the priest shall bring all of them and place them upon the altar. It is an offering of sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.1:14: And if you bring an offering from the birds as a gift to the Lord, then he shall bring his gift from the turtledoves or from the doves.
verses.1:15: And the priest shall bring it to the altar, and pinch off the head, and the priest shall place it upon the altar, and he shall drain out the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.1:16: And he shall remove the crop with the feathers and cast it beside the altar toward the east, into the place of the ashes.
verses.1:17: And he shall break it open by its wings, yet he shall not divide it; and the priest shall place it upon the altar, upon the wood that is on the fire. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.'"
verses.2:1: Now if a soul brings a gift, a sacrifice to the Lord, his gift shall be fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it and put frankincense upon it. It is a sacrifice.
verses.2:2: And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests; and taking from it a full handful of the fine flour with the oil, and all its frankincense, the priest shall place its memorial upon the altar: a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.2:3: And the remainder of the sacrifice shall belong to Aaron and to his sons, a most holy thing from the sacrifices of the Lord.
verses.2:4: And if he brings a gift, a sacrifice baked from frankincense, a gift to the Lord of fine flour—unleavened loaves mixed with oil and unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.2:5: And if your gift is a sacrifice from a pan, fine flour mixed with oil, it is unleavened;
verses.2:6: and you shall break them into pieces and pour oil upon them. It is a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.2:7: And if your gift is a sacrifice from a hearth, it shall be made with oil.
verses.2:8: And he shall bring to the Lord the sacrifice that he makes from these things, and he shall bring it to the priest; and having drawn near to the altar,
verses.2:9: the priest shall take from the sacrifice its memorial, and the priest shall place it upon the altar: an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.2:10: Now that which remains of the sacrifice shall belong to Aaron and to his sons, most holy things from the offerings of the Lord.
verses.2:11: No sacrifice that you bring to the Lord shall you make leavened; for of any leaven or any honey you shall bring none to offer by fire to the Lord.
verses.2:12: As a gift of firstfruits you shall bring them to the Lord; yet upon the altar they shall not be brought up for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.2:13: And every gift of your sacrifice shall be salted with salt; you shall not let the salt of the covenant of the Lord cease from your sacrifices; upon every gift of yours you shall bring salt to the Lord your God.
verses.2:14: And if you bring a sacrifice of firstfruits to the Lord, it shall be tender—new, roasted, crushed groats to the Lord; and you shall bring the sacrifice of the firstfruits,
verses.2:15: and you shall pour oil upon it and put frankincense upon it. It is a sacrifice.
verses.2:16: And the priest shall offer up its memorial from the groats with the oil, and all its frankincense. It is an offering to the Lord.
verses.3:1: Now if his gift to the Lord is a sacrifice of deliverance, if he brings it from his herds, whether male or female, he shall bring it without blemish before the Lord.
verses.3:2: And he shall lay his hands upon the head of the gift and slay it before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood upon the altar of whole burnt offerings all around.
verses.3:3: And they shall bring from the sacrifice of deliverance an offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is upon the belly,
verses.3:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the thighs; and the lobe that is on the liver he shall remove along with the kidneys.
verses.3:5: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall offer them up upon the altar, upon the whole burnt offerings, upon the wood that is on the fire upon the altar: an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.3:6: And if his gift is from the flocks, a sacrifice of deliverance to the Lord, male or female, he shall bring it without blemish.
verses.3:7: If he brings a lamb as his gift, he shall bring it before the Lord;
verses.3:8: and he shall lay his hands upon the head of his gift and slay it beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood upon the altar all around.
verses.3:9: And he shall bring from the sacrifice of deliverance an offering to God: the fat and the unblemished loin—he shall remove it along with the flanks—and the fat of the belly,
verses.3:10: and both kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the thighs; and having removed the lobe that is on the liver along with the kidneys,
verses.3:11: the priest shall offer them up upon the altar: an aroma of sweet fragrance, an offering to the Lord.
verses.3:12: And if his gift is from the goats, then he shall bring it before the Lord;
verses.3:13: and he shall lay his hands upon its head, and they shall slay it before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood upon the altar all around.
verses.3:14: And he shall offer up upon it an offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is upon the belly,
verses.3:15: and both kidneys and all the fat that is on them, which is on the thighs; and the lobe of the liver he shall remove along with the kidneys.
verses.3:16: And the priest shall offer them up upon the altar: an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord. All the fat belongs to the Lord.
verses.3:17: It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings: you shall eat neither any fat nor any blood.
verses.4:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'If a soul sins unintentionally before the Lord against any of the ordinances of the Lord which ought not to be done, and does any one of them:
verses.4:3: if the anointed high priest sins, causing the people to sin, then he shall bring for his sin which he has sinned a young bull from the herd, without blemish, to the Lord for his sin.
verses.4:4: And he shall bring the young bull to the door of the tabernacle of testimony before the Lord, and he shall lay his hand upon the head of the young bull before the Lord, and he shall slay the young bull in the presence of the Lord.
verses.4:5: And the anointed priest whose hands have been consecrated shall take some of the blood of the young bull and bring it into the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:6: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord toward the holy veil.
verses.4:7: And the priest shall put some of the blood of the young bull upon the horns of the altar of compound incense which is before the Lord in the tabernacle of testimony; and all the blood of the young bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offerings, which is by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:8: And all the fat of the young bull of the sin offering he shall remove from it, the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is upon the inward parts,
verses.4:9: and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the lobe that is on the liver with the kidneys, he shall remove it,
verses.4:10: just as you take it away from the young bull of the sacrifice of deliverance; and the priest shall offer it up upon the altar of the offering by fire.
verses.4:11: And the hide of the young bull and all its flesh, with its head and its extremities, and its belly and its dung—
verses.4:12: they shall carry the whole young bull outside the camp to a clean place where they pour out the ashes, and they shall burn it up on wood with fire; at the place where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.
verses.4:13: And if the whole congregation of Israel errs in ignorance unintentionally, and the matter is hidden from the eyes of the congregation, and they do one of all the commandments of the Lord which shall not be done, and they incur guilt,
verses.4:14: and the sin which they have sinned in it becomes known to them, then the congregation shall bring a young bull from the herd, without blemish, for the sin, and shall bring it to the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:15: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the young bull before the Lord, and they shall slay the young bull before the Lord.
verses.4:16: And the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the young bull into the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:17: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood of the young bull, and sprinkle seven times before the Lord directly in front of the holy veil.
verses.4:18: And some of the blood the priest shall put upon the horns of the altar of compound incense, which is before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of testimony; and all the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of offerings by fire, which is at the door of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.4:19: And all the fat he shall remove from it and offer it up upon the altar.
verses.4:20: And he shall do with the young bull just as he did with the young bull of the sin offering; so shall it be done. And the priest shall make atonement for them, and the sin shall be forgiven them.
verses.4:21: And they shall carry the young bull outside the camp, and they shall burn up the young bull just as they burned up the first young bull; it is a sin offering of the congregation.
verses.4:22: And if the ruler sins and does one of all the commandments of the Lord their God which shall not be done, unintentionally, and sins and incurs guilt,
verses.4:23: and the sin which he has sinned in it becomes known to him, then he shall bring his gift, a kid from the goats, a male without blemish.
verses.4:24: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the kid, and they shall slay it in the place where they slay the burnt offerings before the Lord; it is a sin offering.
verses.4:25: And the priest shall put some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger upon the horns of the altar of burnt offerings, and all its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offerings.
verses.4:26: And all its fat he shall offer up upon the altar, like the fat of a sacrifice of deliverance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.4:27: And if one soul from the people of the land sins unintentionally in doing one of all the commandments of the Lord which shall not be done, and incurs guilt,
verses.4:28: and the sin which he has sinned in it becomes known to him, then he shall bring a young she-goat from the goats; a female without blemish he shall bring for the sin which he has sinned.
verses.4:29: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his sin offering, and they shall slay the young she-goat of the sin offering in the place where they slay the burnt offerings.
verses.4:30: And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offerings, and all its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
verses.4:31: And all the fat he shall remove, just as fat is removed from a sacrifice of deliverance, and the priest shall offer it up upon the altar for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.4:32: And if he brings a sheep as his gift for a sin offering, he shall bring it as a female without blemish.
verses.4:33: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and they shall slay it in the place where they slay the burnt offerings.
verses.4:34: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and all its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.4:35: And all its fat he shall remove, just as the fat of a sheep is removed from the sacrifice of deliverance, and the priest shall place it upon the altar upon the burnt offering of the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.'"
verses.5:1: "And if a soul sins and hears the voice of an adjuration, and he is a witness, whether he has seen or knows of it—if he does not report it, he shall bear the sin.
verses.5:2: Or if a soul touches any unclean thing, whether a carcass or an unclean animal torn by wild beasts, or any of the carcasses or of the unclean abominations or of the carcasses of unclean beasts,
verses.5:3: or touches any uncleanness of man, of all his uncleanness by touching which he becomes defiled, and it was hidden from him, yet afterward he comes to know it and incurs guilt;
verses.5:4: or the lawless soul who pronounces with his lips to do evil or to do good, according to whatever a man pronounces with an oath, and it escapes him before his eyes, and he comes to know it and sins in any one of these things—
verses.5:5: then he shall confess the sin concerning the things in which he has sinned regarding it,
verses.5:6: and he shall bring for the things in which he has trespassed against the Lord, for his sin which he has sinned, a female from the flock, a ewe lamb or a young she-goat from the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and the sin shall be forgiven him.
verses.5:7: And if his hand cannot afford enough for the sheep, he shall bring for his sin which he has sinned two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the Lord, one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.
verses.5:8: And he shall bring them to the priest, and the priest shall offer the one for the sin offering first; and the priest shall wring its head at the neck, yet he shall not divide it.
verses.5:9: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood he shall drain out at the base of the altar; for it is a sin offering.
verses.5:10: And the second he shall prepare as a burnt offering as is prescribed; and the priest shall make atonement concerning his sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.5:11: And if his hand cannot find a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his gift for that in which he has sinned the tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall not pour oil upon it, nor shall he put frankincense upon it, because it is for a sin offering.
verses.5:12: And he shall bring it to the priest. And the priest, taking a full handful from it, shall place its memorial portion upon the altar of burnt offerings to the Lord; it is a sin offering.
verses.5:13: And the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned in any one of these things, and it shall be forgiven him. And what remains shall belong to the priest, like the offering of fine flour."
verses.5:14: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:15: "If a soul genuinely forgets and sins unintentionally regarding the holy things of the Lord, then he shall bring for his trespass to the Lord a ram without blemish from the flock, valued in shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for that in which he has trespassed.
verses.5:16: And what he has sinned regarding the holy things he shall repay, and he shall add one-fifth to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.5:17: And the soul who sins and does one of all the commandments of the Lord which ought not to be done, and did not know it, yet incurs guilt and bears the sin,
verses.5:18: then he shall bring a ram without blemish from the flock, valued in silver for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his ignorance in which he erred ignorantly, though he himself did not know it, and it shall be forgiven him;
verses.5:19: for he has surely committed a trespass before the Lord."
verses.5:20: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:21: "If a soul sins and willfully disregards the commandments of the Lord, and deals falsely in matters toward his neighbor concerning a deposit, or concerning a partnership, or concerning robbery, or has wronged his neighbor in anything,
verses.5:22: or has found a lost thing and lies concerning it, and swears unjustly concerning any one of all the things that a man may do so as to sin in them:
verses.5:23: then it shall be, whenever he sins and incurs guilt, that he shall restore the plunder which he robbed, or what he took by wronging him, or the deposit which was entrusted to him, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.5:24: concerning any matter about which he swore unjustly, he shall repay the principal itself, and he shall add one-fifth to it; to the one whose it is, to him he shall restore it on the day he is convicted.
verses.5:25: And for his trespass he shall bring to the Lord a ram without blemish from the flock, according to the valuation, for that in which he has trespassed.
verses.5:26: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and it shall be forgiven him concerning any one of all the things which he has done and incurred guilt in it."
verses.6:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:2: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering itself shall remain on its burning place on the altar all night until morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not be put out.
verses.6:3: And the priest shall put on a linen tunic, and he shall put linen trousers upon his body, and he shall take up the consumed remains which the fire has consumed—the burnt offering—from the altar, and place them beside the altar.
verses.6:4: Then he shall take off his garment and put on another garment, and carry the consumed remains outside the camp to a clean place.
verses.6:5: And fire upon the altar shall be kept burning from it, and it shall not be put out; and the priest shall burn wood on it in the morning, and stack the burnt offering upon it, and place upon it the fat of the deliverance offering.
verses.6:6: And fire shall burn continually upon the altar; it shall not be put out.
verses.6:7: This is the law of the sacrifice which the sons of Aaron shall bring near before the Lord, in front of the altar:
verses.6:8: He shall take from it with his handful some of the fine flour of the sacrifice, with its oil and with its frankincense that are upon the sacrifice, and he shall offer it up upon the altar as an offering made by fire—a sweet aroma, its memorial portion to the Lord.
verses.6:9: And the remainder of it Aaron and his sons shall eat; it shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place—in the court of the tabernacle of testimony they shall eat it.
verses.6:10: It shall not be baked leavened. I have given it to them as a portion from the offerings made by fire to the Lord; it is most holy, like the sin offering and like the trespass offering.
verses.6:11: Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations from the offerings made by fire to the Lord. Everyone who touches them shall be made holy.'"
verses.6:12: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:13: "This is the gift of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord on the day when you anoint him: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a perpetual sacrifice, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
verses.6:14: It shall be prepared on a griddle with oil; kneaded well he shall bring it—rolled pieces, a sacrifice of broken pieces, a sacrifice as a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.6:15: The priest from among his sons who is anointed in his place shall prepare it. It is a perpetual law; the whole of it shall be completely offered.
verses.6:16: And every sacrifice of a priest shall be wholly burned; it shall not be eaten."
verses.6:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:18: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where they slay the burnt offering, they shall slay the sin offering before the Lord; it is most holy.
verses.6:19: The priest who offers it up shall eat it. In a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.6:20: Everyone who touches its flesh shall be made holy; and whoever has any of its blood sprinkled upon a garment—that upon which it is sprinkled shall be washed in a holy place.
verses.6:21: And an earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; but if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, he shall scour it and rinse it out with water.
verses.6:22: Every male among the priests shall eat them; they are most holy to the Lord.
verses.6:23: And all sin offerings from which any of their blood is brought into the tabernacle of testimony to make atonement in the holy place shall not be eaten; they shall be burned up with fire.'"
verses.7:1: "And this is the law of the ram for the trespass offering: it is most holy.
verses.7:2: In the place where they slay the burnt offering, they shall slay the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord; and he shall pour out the blood upon the base of the altar all around.
verses.7:3: And he shall offer from it all its fat: both the loin and all the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,
verses.7:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is by the thighs, and the lobe that is on the liver; with the kidneys he shall remove them.
verses.7:5: And the priest shall offer them up on the altar as an offering made by fire to the Lord; it is for a trespass.
verses.7:6: Every male among the priests shall eat them; in a holy place they shall eat them; they are most holy.
verses.7:7: As is the sin offering, so also is the trespass offering; there is one law for them: the priest who makes atonement, it shall belong to him.
verses.7:8: And the priest who brings near a man's burnt offering, the hide of the burnt offering which he himself offers shall belong to him.
verses.7:9: And every sacrifice that is prepared in the oven, and every one that is prepared on a hearth or on a griddle, belongs to the priest who offers it; it shall be his.
verses.7:10: And every sacrifice mixed with oil, and every one not mixed, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, to each one an equal share.
verses.7:11: This is the law of the sacrifice of deliverance which they shall offer to the Lord:
verses.7:12: If he offers it for praise, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of praise loaves of fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and fine flour kneaded with oil.
verses.7:13: With leavened loaves he shall offer his gifts, along with the sacrifice of praise of deliverance.
verses.7:14: And he shall bring near one from all his gifts as a set-apart portion to the Lord; to the priest who pours out the blood of the deliverance offering, to him it shall belong.
verses.7:15: And the flesh of the sacrifice of praise of deliverance shall belong to him; and on the day it is presented as a gift, it shall be eaten; they shall not leave any of it until morning.
verses.7:16: And if he sacrifices his gift as a vow or a freewill offering, on the day that he brings near his sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on the next day.
verses.7:17: And what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice until the third day shall be burned up with fire.
verses.7:18: But if he indeed eats any of the flesh on the third day, it shall not be accepted for him who offers it; it shall not be credited to him; it is a defilement, and the soul that eats of it shall bear the sin.
verses.7:19: And any flesh that touches anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned up with fire. Everyone who is clean shall eat flesh.
verses.7:20: But the soul that eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of deliverance, which belongs to the Lord, while his uncleanness is upon him, that soul shall perish from among its people.
verses.7:21: And a soul that touches any unclean thing, whether of human uncleanness, or of the unclean four-footed animals, or of any unclean abomination, and eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of deliverance, which belongs to the Lord, that soul shall perish from among its people."
verses.7:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:23: "Speak to the sons of Israel, 'You shall not eat any fat of oxen, or of sheep, or of goats.
verses.7:24: And the fat of what dies of itself and what is caught by wild beasts shall be used for any work, and for food it shall not be eaten.
verses.7:25: Everyone who eats fat from the livestock of which one brings near an offering made by fire to the Lord, that soul shall perish from its people.
verses.7:26: You shall not eat any blood in all the land of your dwelling, whether of birds or of livestock.
verses.7:27: Every soul that eats blood, that soul shall perish from its people.'"
verses.7:28: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:29: "And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying, 'He who offers a sacrifice of deliverance to the Lord shall bring his gift to the Lord also from the sacrifice of deliverance.
verses.7:30: His own hands shall offer the offerings made by fire to the Lord: the fat that is on the breast and the lobe of the liver, he shall offer them so as to place a gift before the Lord.
verses.7:31: And the priest shall offer up the fat upon the altar, and the breast shall belong to Aaron and shall belong to his sons.
verses.7:32: And the right shoulder you shall give as a set-apart portion to the priest from the sacrifices of your deliverance offerings.
verses.7:33: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the deliverance offering and the fat, to him shall belong the right shoulder as a portion.
verses.7:34: For the breast of the presentation offering and the shoulder of the set-apart portion I have taken from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of your deliverance offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as a perpetual statute from the sons of Israel.'"
verses.7:35: This is the anointing portion of Aaron and the anointing portion of his sons from the offerings made by fire to the Lord, on the day He brought them near to minister as priests to the Lord,
verses.7:36: just as the Lord commanded to be given to them from the sons of Israel on the day He anointed them, a perpetual statute throughout their generations.
verses.7:37: This is the law of the burnt offerings, and of the sacrifice, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of deliverance,
verses.7:38: in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day He commanded the sons of Israel to offer their gifts before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.8:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:2: "Take Aaron and his sons, and his garments, and the anointing oil, and the young bull for the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,
verses.8:3: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the tabernacle of witness."
verses.8:4: And Moses did just as the Lord commanded him, and he assembled the congregation at the door of the tabernacle of witness.
verses.8:5: And Moses said to the congregation, "This is the thing—this is what the Lord commanded to do."
verses.8:6: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons near, and washed them with water.
verses.8:7: And he clothed them with the tunic and girded them with the sash; and he clothed him with the robe and put the ephod upon him,
verses.8:8: and he girded him according to the workmanship of the ephod and bound him tightly with it; and he placed the oracle upon it, and upon the oracle he placed the Manifestation and the Truth.
verses.8:9: And he placed the turban upon his head, and upon the front of the turban he placed the golden plate, consecrated and holy, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.8:10: And Moses took some of the anointing oil,
verses.8:11: and sprinkled some of it upon the altar seven times; and he anointed the altar and sanctified it, and all its utensils, and the laver and its base, and sanctified them; and he anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified it.
verses.8:12: And Moses poured some of the anointing oil upon the head of Aaron, and anointed him and sanctified him.
verses.8:13: And Moses brought the sons of Aaron near, and clothed them with tunics, and girded them with sashes, and put headdresses upon them, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.8:14: And Moses brought forward the young bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the young bull for the sin offering.
verses.8:15: And he slew it; and Moses took some of the blood and put it upon the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and cleansed the altar; and he poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it to make atonement upon it.
verses.8:16: And Moses took all the fat that was upon the entrails, and the lobe from the liver, and both kidneys and the fat that was upon them, and Moses offered them up upon the altar.
verses.8:17: But the young bull, and its hide, and its flesh, and its dung, he burned completely with fire outside the camp, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.8:18: And Moses brought forward the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram. And Moses slew the ram, and Moses poured out the blood upon the altar all around.
verses.8:20: And he cut the ram into pieces, and Moses offered up the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.8:21: And he washed the inward parts and the legs with water, and Moses offered up the entire ram upon the altar; it was a burnt offering for a sweet-smelling aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.8:22: And Moses brought forward the second ram, the ram of consecration; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.8:23: And he slew it, and Moses took some of its blood and put it upon the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and upon the tip of his right hand, and upon the tip of his right foot.
verses.8:24: And Moses brought the sons of Aaron near; and Moses put some of the blood upon the lobes of their right ears, and upon the tips of their right hands, and upon the tips of their right feet; and Moses poured out the blood upon the altar all around.
verses.8:25: And he took the fat, and the loin, and the fat that was upon the inward parts, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that was upon them, and the right shoulder;
verses.8:26: and from the basket of consecration that was before the Lord he took one unleavened loaf, and one loaf made with oil, and one wafer, and placed them upon the fat and placed the right shoulder upon them;
verses.8:27: and he placed all of them upon the hands of Aaron and upon the hands of his sons, and offered them up as a dedicated offering before the Lord.
verses.8:28: And Moses took them from their hands, and Moses offered them up upon the altar, upon the burnt offering of consecration, which is a sweet-smelling aroma; it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.8:29: And Moses took the breast and separated it as a presentation offering before the Lord from the ram of consecration; and it became Moses' portion, just as the Lord commanded Moses. And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron and his garments and his sons.
verses.8:30: And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him, and the garments of his sons with him.
verses.8:31: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, "Boil the flesh in the court of the tabernacle of witness, in a holy place, and there you shall eat it and the loaves in the basket of consecration, just as it has been commanded to me, saying, 'Aaron and his sons shall eat these.'
verses.8:32: And what remains of the flesh and of the loaves shall be burned completely with fire.
verses.8:33: And you shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of witness for seven days, until the day of your consecration is fulfilled; for seven days He will consecrate your hands,
verses.8:34: just as He has done on this day, which the Lord commanded to be done to make atonement for you.
verses.8:35: And you shall abide at the door of the tabernacle of witness seven days, day and night; you shall keep the charges of the Lord, lest you die; for so the Lord God has commanded me."
verses.8:36: And Aaron and his sons did all the words that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.9:1: And it came to pass on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the council of elders of Israel.
verses.9:2: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take for yourself a tender calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord;
verses.9:3: and speak to the council of elders of Israel, saying, 'Take one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb a year old for a whole burnt offering, without blemish,
verses.9:4: and a young bull and a ram for a sacrifice of deliverance before the Lord, and fine flour mixed with oil; for today the Lord will appear among you.'"
verses.9:5: And they took what Moses commanded before the tabernacle of witness; and all the congregation drew near, and stood before the Lord.
verses.9:6: And Moses said, "Do this thing that the Lord has spoken, and the glory of the Lord will appear among you."
verses.9:7: And Moses said to Aaron, "Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for your household; and offer the gifts of the people, and make atonement for them, just as the Lord commanded Moses."
verses.9:8: And Aaron drew near to the altar, and slew the calf for the sin offering.
verses.9:9: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.9:10: And the fat, and the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver from the sin offering he offered up upon the altar, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.9:11: And the flesh and the hide he burned completely with fire outside the camp.
verses.9:12: And he slew the burnt offering; and the sons of Aaron brought the blood also to him, and he poured it upon the altar all around.
verses.9:13: And as for the burnt offering, they brought it in pieces, both the pieces and the head, and he placed them upon the altar.
verses.9:14: And he washed the inward parts and the legs with water, and placed them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.9:15: And they brought forward the gift of the people; and he took the male goat for the sin offering of the people, and slew it, just as he did the first.
verses.9:16: And he brought forward the burnt offering, and offered it as is fitting.
verses.9:17: And he brought forward the offering, and filled his hands from it, and placed it upon the altar, besides the morning burnt offering.
verses.9:18: And he slew the young bull and the ram of the sacrifice of deliverance, which was for the people; and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it against the altar all around;
verses.9:19: and the fat from the young bull and from the ram—the loin, and the fat covering the inward parts, and the two kidneys and the fat that was upon them, and the lobe that was upon the liver;
verses.9:20: and he placed the fat portions upon the breasts, and they offered up the fat portions upon the altar;
verses.9:21: and the breast and the right shoulder Aaron set apart as a dedicated offering before the Lord, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.9:22: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and came down after offering the sin offering, and the burnt offerings, and the offerings of deliverance.
verses.9:23: And Moses and Aaron entered into the tabernacle of witness, and when they came out they blessed all the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.
verses.9:24: And fire went out from the Lord and consumed what was upon the altar, both the burnt offerings and the fat portions; and all the people saw it and were astounded, and fell upon their faces.
verses.10:1: Then the two sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, each took his censer, put fire upon it, laid incense upon it, and offered before the Lord strange fire, which the Lord had not commanded them.
verses.10:2: And fire came forth from the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.10:3: And Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord spoke, saying, 'Among those who draw near to Me I will be sanctified, and in all the congregation I will be glorified.'" And Aaron was pierced to the heart.
verses.10:4: And Moses called Misadai and Elisaphan, sons of Aziel, sons of the brother of Aaron's father, and said to them, "Come near and carry your brethren from before the sanctuary, outside the camp."
verses.10:5: So they came near and carried them in their tunics outside the camp, just as Moses had spoken.
verses.10:6: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar his remaining sons, "You shall not take off the turbans from your heads, nor shall you tear your garments, lest you die and wrath come upon all the congregation. Your brethren, all the house of Israel, shall weep over the burning with which they were burned by the Lord.
verses.10:7: And you shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of testimony, lest you die; for the anointing oil from the Lord is upon you." And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.10:8: Then the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying,
verses.10:9: "You shall not drink wine or strong drink, you and your sons with you, whenever you enter the tabernacle of testimony, or when you approach the altar, and you shall by no means die; it shall be an everlasting statute throughout your generations,
verses.10:10: to distinguish between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean,
verses.10:11: and you shall instruct the sons of Israel in all the statutes which the Lord has spoken to them by the hand of Moses."
verses.10:12: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, the remaining sons of Aaron, "Take the sacrifice that remains from the offerings of the Lord, and eat it unleavened beside the altar; it is most holy.
verses.10:13: And you shall eat it in a holy place, for this is an everlasting statute for you and a statute for your sons from the offerings of the Lord; for so it has been commanded me.
verses.10:14: And the breast of the set-apart offering and the shoulder of the contribution you shall eat in a holy place, you and your sons and your household with you; for it has been given as a statute for you and a statute for your sons from the sacrifices of salvation of the sons of Israel.
verses.10:15: The shoulder of the contribution and the breast of the set-apart offering they shall bring with the offerings of the fat portions, to set apart as a set-apart offering before the Lord; and it shall be for you and for your sons and for your daughters with you as an everlasting statute, just as the Lord commanded Moses."
verses.10:16: Then Moses inquired diligently about the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it had been burned up! And Moses was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the remaining sons of Aaron, saying,
verses.10:17: "Why did you not eat the sin offering in a holy place? For because it is most holy, He has given this to you to eat, that you may take away the sin of the congregation and make atonement for them before the Lord.
verses.10:18: For none of its blood was brought into the sanctuary; you were to eat it directly inside, in a holy place, just as the Lord commanded me."
verses.10:19: And Aaron spoke to Moses, saying, "If today they have offered their sin offerings and their whole burnt offerings before the Lord, and these things have befallen me, and I eat the sin offerings today, would it be pleasing to the Lord?"
verses.10:20: And Moses heard, and it pleased him.
verses.11:1: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.11:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'These are the beasts which you may eat from among the beasts that are on the earth:
verses.11:3: Every beast that parts the hoof, dividing the clefts into two hooves, and brings up the cud, among the beasts—these you may eat.
verses.11:4: Nevertheless, of these you shall not eat, among those that bring up the cud and among those that part the hooves and divide the clefts: the camel, because it brings up the cud, yet does not part the hoof—it is unclean to you;
verses.11:5: and the hare, because it brings up the cud and does not part the hoof—it is unclean to you;
verses.11:6: and the rock badger, because it brings up the cud and does not part the hoof—it is unclean to you.
verses.11:7: And the swine, because it parts the hoof and divides the clefts of the hoof, yet does not bring up the cud—it is unclean to you.
verses.11:8: Of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch; these are unclean to you.
verses.11:9: And these you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the streams, these you may eat.
verses.11:10: And all that do not have fins or scales in the water, or in the seas and in the streams, of all things that the waters bring forth and of every living creature that is in the water, are an abomination; and abominations they shall be
verses.11:11: to you; of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall hold in abomination.
verses.11:12: And whatever does not have fins and scales among those in the water, this is an abomination to you.
verses.11:13: And these are what you shall hold in abomination among the birds, and they shall not be eaten—they are an abomination: the eagle, the bearded vulture, and the sea eagle,
verses.11:14: the vulture, and the kite and those like it,
verses.11:16: the ostrich, the owl, the gull and those like it, and the hawk and those like it,
verses.11:17: the night raven, the cormorant, and the ibis,
verses.11:18: the purple water hen, the pelican, and the swan,
verses.11:19: the owl, the heron, the plover and those like it, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.11:20: And all winged creeping things that go on all fours are abominations to you.
verses.11:21: Yet these you may eat among the winged creeping things that go on all fours—such as has legs above its feet to leap with them upon the earth.
verses.11:22: And these of them you may eat: the wingless locust and those like it, the cricket and those like it, the locust and those like it, and the grasshopper and those like it.
verses.11:23: Every creeping thing among the winged creatures that has four feet—these are abominations to you.
verses.11:24: And by these you shall be defiled: whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening,
verses.11:25: and whoever carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening.
verses.11:26: And among all the beasts, every one that parts the hoof and divides the clefts, yet does not chew the cud, shall be unclean to you; whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening.
verses.11:27: And whatever walks on its paws, among all the wild beasts that go on all fours, these shall be unclean to you; whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening,
verses.11:28: and whoever carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening; these are unclean to you.
verses.11:29: And these are unclean to you among the creeping things that are upon the earth: the weasel, the mouse, and the land crocodile,
verses.11:30: the shrew, the chameleon, the gecko, the lizard, and the mole.
verses.11:31: These are unclean to you among all the creeping things that are upon the earth; whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.
verses.11:32: And anything upon which any of them falls when they are dead shall be unclean, whether any vessel of wood, or garment, or skin, or sackcloth; every vessel with which any work is done shall be dipped into water, and it shall be unclean until evening, and then it shall be clean.
verses.11:33: And every earthen vessel into which any of these falls, whatever is inside it shall be unclean, and it shall be broken.
verses.11:34: And every food that is eaten, upon which water comes, shall be unclean; and every drink that is drunk in any vessel shall be unclean.
verses.11:35: And everything upon which any part of their carcasses falls shall be unclean; ovens and pot stands shall be broken down; they are unclean, and they shall be unclean to you.
verses.11:36: Nevertheless, springs of water, and a cistern, and a gathering of water shall be clean; but whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean.
verses.11:37: And if any of their carcasses falls upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean;
verses.11:38: but if water has been poured upon any seed, and any of their carcasses falls upon it, it is unclean to you.
verses.11:39: And if any of the beasts dies which is yours to eat, whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening;
verses.11:40: and whoever eats of these carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening; and whoever carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.11:41: And every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth—this shall be an abomination to you; it shall not be eaten.
verses.11:42: And every creature that goes on its belly, and every creature that goes continually on all fours, whatever has many feet among all the creeping things that creep upon the earth—you shall not eat it, for it is an abomination to you.
verses.11:43: And you shall by no means make your souls abominable with any of the creeping things that creep upon the earth, nor shall you defile yourselves with these, nor shall you become unclean by them.
verses.11:44: For I am the Lord your God; therefore you shall be sanctified and you shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy; and you shall not defile your souls with any of the creeping things that move upon the earth.
verses.11:45: For I am the Lord who brought you up out of the land of Egypt to be your God; therefore you shall be holy, for I the Lord am holy.'"
verses.11:46: This is the law concerning the beasts, and the birds, and every creature that moves in the water, and every creature that creeps upon the earth,
verses.11:47: to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between the creatures that bring forth living young that may be eaten and those that bring forth living young that may not be eaten.
verses.12:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.12:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'Any woman who receives seed and bears a male shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation of her menstruation, she shall be unclean.
verses.12:3: And on the eighth day she shall circumcise the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.12:4: And for thirty-three days she shall remain in her unclean blood; she shall not touch any vessel, and she shall not enter the sanctuary, until the days of her purification are fulfilled.
verses.12:5: But if she bears a female, she shall be unclean twice seven days, according to her menstruation; and for sixty-six days she shall remain in her unclean blood.
verses.12:6: And when the days of her purification are completed, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb a year old, without blemish, for a whole burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering, to the door of the tabernacle of witness, to the priest.
verses.12:7: And he shall offer them before the Lord, and the priest shall make atonement for her, and he shall cleanse her from the fountain of her blood. This is the law for her who bears a male or a female.
verses.12:8: But if her hand does not find enough for a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a whole burnt offering and one for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be cleansed.'"
verses.13:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.13:2: If any man has on the skin of his flesh a bright scar of a mark, and it becomes on the skin of his flesh a plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest, or to one of his sons the priests.
verses.13:3: And the priest shall examine the plague on the skin of his flesh; and if the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is lower than the skin of the flesh, it is a plague of leprosy; and the priest shall look upon it and pronounce him unclean.
verses.13:4: But if there is a bright white spot on the skin of his flesh, and its appearance is not lower than his skin, and his hair has not turned to white hair, and it is dim, then the priest shall isolate the plague for seven days.
verses.13:5: And the priest shall examine the plague on the seventh day; and behold, the plague remains before him, and the plague has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven days a second time.
verses.13:6: And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day a second time; and behold, the plague is dim, and the plague has not spread on the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is a mark; and after washing his garments, he shall be clean.
verses.13:7: But if the mark changes and spreads on the skin after the priest has examined him to pronounce him clean, then he shall appear a second time before the priest;
verses.13:8: and the priest shall examine him; and behold, the mark has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.13:9: And if a plague of leprosy is on a man, then he shall come to the priest;
verses.13:10: and the priest shall examine him; and behold, there is a white scar on the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is some of the sound, living flesh in the scar,
verses.13:11: it is an old leprosy; it is on the skin of the flesh; and the priest shall pronounce him unclean and isolate him, because he is unclean.
verses.13:12: And if the leprosy breaks out abundantly on the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the plague from head to foot, as far as the entire sight of the priest reaches,
verses.13:13: then the priest shall look, and behold, the leprosy has covered all the skin of the flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague; because all of it has turned white, it is clean.
verses.13:14: And on whatever day living flesh appears on him, he shall be unclean;
verses.13:15: and the priest shall examine the sound flesh, and the sound flesh shall defile him, because it is unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.13:16: But if the sound flesh is restored and turns white, then he shall come to the priest;
verses.13:17: and the priest shall examine him, and behold, the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce the plague clean; he is clean.
verses.13:18: And if the flesh has a sore on its skin, and it is healed,
verses.13:19: and in the place of the sore there arises a white scar, or a bright spot that is whitish or reddish, then he shall appear before the priest.
verses.13:20: And the priest shall examine it; and behold, its appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is leprosy; it has broken out in the sore.
verses.13:21: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin of the flesh, and it is dim, the priest shall isolate him for seven days.
verses.13:22: And if it spreads on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a plague of leprosy; it has broken out in the sore.
verses.13:23: But if the bright spot remains in its place and does not spread, it is the scar of the sore, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.13:24: And if the flesh has a burn of fire on its skin, and the healed part of the burn on its skin becomes a shining, bright white spot, somewhat reddish or very white,
verses.13:25: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, the hair in the shining spot has turned white, and its appearance is lower than the skin, it is leprosy; it has broken out in the burn; and the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a plague of leprosy.
verses.13:26: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the shining spot, and it is not lower than the skin, and it is dim, then the priest shall isolate him for seven days.
verses.13:27: And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day; and if it indeed spreads on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a plague of leprosy; it has broken out in the sore.
verses.13:28: But if the shining spot remains in its place and has not spread on the skin, and it is dim, it is the scar of the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the imprint of the burn.
verses.13:29: And if either a man or a woman has a plague of leprosy on the head or on the beard,
verses.13:30: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, its appearance is deeper than the skin, and in it there is thin yellowish hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a scale; it is leprosy of the head or leprosy of the beard.
verses.13:31: And if the priest examines the plague of the wound, and behold, its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and there is no yellowish hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the plague of the scale for seven days;
verses.13:32: and the priest shall examine the plague on the seventh day; and behold, the scale has not spread, and there is no yellowish hair in it, and the appearance of the scale is not sunken below the skin,
verses.13:33: then the skin shall be shaved, but the scale shall not be shaved, and the priest shall isolate the scale for seven days a second time.
verses.13:34: And the priest shall examine the scale on the seventh day; and behold, the scale has not spread on the skin after he was shaved, and the appearance of the scale is not sunken below the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; and after washing his garments, he shall be clean.
verses.13:35: But if the scale indeed spreads on the skin after he has been pronounced clean,
verses.13:36: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, the scale has spread on the skin, the priest shall not inspect for yellow hair, because he is unclean;
verses.13:37: but if the scale remains in its place before him and black hair grows up in it, the scale has healed; it is clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.13:38: And if a man or a woman has on the skin of his flesh a shining spot, shining whitish spots,
verses.13:39: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, on the skin of his flesh there are gleaming, whitish spots, it is a white rash; he is clean; it will break out on the skin of his flesh; he is clean.
verses.13:40: And if anyone loses the hair of his head, he is bald; he is clean;
verses.13:41: and if his head loses its hair toward the front, he is bald on the forehead; he is clean.
verses.13:42: But if there arises on his bald head or on his bald forehead a white or reddish plague, it is leprosy on his bald head or on his bald forehead;
verses.13:43: and the priest shall examine him; and behold, the appearance of the plague is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy on the skin of his flesh,
verses.13:44: he is a leprous man; the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his plague is on his head.
verses.13:45: And as for the leper in whom the plague is, let his garments be loosened, and his head uncovered, and let him put a covering around his mouth, and he shall be called unclean;
verses.13:46: all the days that the plague is upon him, being unclean, he shall be unclean; he shall dwell apart; outside the camp shall be his dwelling.
verses.13:47: And if a garment has a plague of leprosy in it, whether in a woolen garment or in a flaxen garment,
verses.13:48: or in the warp or in the woof, either of linen or of wool, or in leather, or in any wrought leather,
verses.13:49: and the plague becomes greenish or reddish in the leather, or in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any wrought article of leather, it is a plague of leprosy, and he shall show it to the priest.
verses.13:50: And the priest shall examine the plague, and the priest shall isolate the plague for seven days.
verses.13:51: And the priest shall examine the plague on the seventh day; and if the plague has spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in the leather, in all leathers that may be made in workmanship, the plague is a persistent leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.13:52: He shall burn the garment, or the warp, or the woof, whether of wool or of linen, or any article of leather in which the plague is; because it is leprosy, it shall be burned in fire.
verses.13:53: But if the priest examines it, and the plague has not spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any article of leather,
verses.13:54: then the priest shall command, and he shall wash that upon which the plague is, and the priest shall isolate the plague for seven days a second time.
verses.13:55: And the priest shall examine the plague after it has been washed; and if this plague has not changed its appearance, and the plague does not spread, it is unclean; it shall be burned in fire; it is fixed fast in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof.
verses.13:56: And if the priest examines it, and the plague is dim after it has been washed, he shall tear it out from the garment, or from the leather, or from the warp, or from the woof.
verses.13:57: But if it still appears in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any article of leather, it is leprosy breaking out; that in which the plague is shall be burned in fire.
verses.13:58: And as for the garment, or the warp, or the woof, or any article of leather that is washed, and the plague departs from it, then it shall be washed a second time; it shall be clean.
verses.13:59: This is the law of the plague of leprosy of a woolen or flaxen garment, or of warp or woof, or of any article of leather, to pronounce it clean or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.14:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.14:2: "This is the law of the leper, on whatever day he is cleansed: he shall be brought to the priest,
verses.14:3: and the priest shall go forth outside the camp; and the priest shall look, and behold, the plague of leprosy is healed from the leper.
verses.14:4: Then the priest shall command, and they shall take for the one who has been cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and spun scarlet, and hyssop;
verses.14:5: and the priest shall command, and they shall slay the one bird into an earthen vessel over living water;
verses.14:6: and as for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the spun scarlet, and the hyssop, and he shall dip them and the living bird into the blood of the bird that was slain over living water;
verses.14:7: and he shall sprinkle upon the one cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and he shall be clean; and he shall send away the living bird into the open field.
verses.14:8: And the one who has been cleansed shall wash his garments, and shave off all his hair, and bathe in water, and he shall be clean; and after these things he shall enter into the camp, and he shall abide outside his house seven days.
verses.14:9: And it shall be on the seventh day that he shall shave off all his hair—his head, and his beard, and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off—and he shall wash the garments and bathe his body with water, and he shall be clean.
verses.14:10: And on the eighth day he shall take two yearling lambs without blemish, and a yearling sheep without blemish, and three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for an offering, and one cotyla of oil;
verses.14:11: and the priest who cleanses shall set the man who is being cleansed, and these things, before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.14:12: And the priest shall take the one lamb and offer it for the trespass offering, along with the cotyla of oil, and he shall set it apart as a separated offering before the Lord.
verses.14:13: And they shall slay the lamb in the place where they slay the burnt offerings and the sin offerings, in a holy place; for the sin offering is like the trespass offering; it belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
verses.14:14: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and upon the tip of the right hand, and upon the tip of the right foot;
verses.14:15: and the priest shall take some from the cotyla of oil and pour it upon the left hand of the priest,
verses.14:16: and he shall dip his right finger into some of the oil that is upon his left hand, and sprinkle seven times with his finger before the Lord.
verses.14:17: And the remaining oil that is in his hand the priest shall put upon the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and upon the tip of the right hand, and upon the tip of the right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering;
verses.14:18: and the remaining oil that is upon the hand of the priest, the priest shall put upon the head of the one who has been cleansed; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.14:19: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him, the unclean one who is being cleansed from his sin; and after this the priest shall slay the burnt offering.
verses.14:20: And the priest shall offer up the burnt offering and the offering upon the altar before the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be cleansed.
verses.14:21: But if his hand is poor and cannot find enough, he shall take one lamb for that in which he trespassed, for an offering set apart, so as to make atonement for him, and a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for an offering, and one cotyla of oil,
verses.14:22: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, as much as his hand has found; and the one shall be for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering;
verses.14:23: and he shall bring them on the eighth day, for his cleansing, to the priest, at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony, before the Lord.
verses.14:24: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering and the cotyla of oil, and present them as a presentation offering before the Lord.
verses.14:25: And he shall slay the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and upon the tip of the right hand, and upon the tip of the right foot.
verses.14:26: And some of the oil the priest shall pour upon the left hand of the priest;
verses.14:27: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord;
verses.14:28: and the priest shall put some of the oil that is upon his hand upon the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and upon the tip of his right hand, and upon the tip of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering;
verses.14:29: and what remains of the oil that is upon the hand of the priest, he shall put upon the head of the one who has been cleansed; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.14:30: And he shall offer one of the turtledoves or from the young pigeons, according as his hand has found,
verses.14:31: the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, with the offering; and the priest shall make atonement for the one being cleansed before the Lord.
verses.14:32: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, and who cannot find with his hand enough for his cleansing."
verses.14:33: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.14:34: "When you enter into the land of the Canaanites, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a plague of leprosy in the houses of the land possessed by you,
verses.14:35: then he to whom the house belongs shall come and report to the priest, saying, 'Something like a plague has been seen in my house.'
verses.14:36: And the priest shall command them to empty the house before the priest enters to look at the house, so that whatever is in the house may by no means become unclean; and after these things the priest shall enter to examine the house.
verses.14:37: And he shall look at the plague in the walls of the house, greenish hollows, and their appearance is lower than the walls;
verses.14:38: and the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and the priest shall set the house apart for seven days.
verses.14:39: And the priest shall return on the seventh day and look at the house, and behold, the plague has not spread in the walls of the house;
verses.14:40: and the priest shall command, and they shall take out the stones—there is the plague—and they shall cast them outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:41: And they shall scrape the house inside all around, and they shall pour out the mortar outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:42: And they shall take solid scraped stones and put them in place of the stones, and they shall take other mortar and plaster the house.
verses.14:43: Now if a plague comes again and breaks out in the house after the stones have been taken out, and after the house has been scraped, and after it has been plastered,
verses.14:44: then the priest shall enter and look; if the plague has spread in the house, it is an abiding leprosy in the house; it is unclean.
verses.14:45: And they shall tear down the house, and its timbers and its stones and all the mortar they shall carry forth outside the city into an unclean place;
verses.14:46: and whoever enters into the house all the days that it is set apart shall be unclean until evening,
verses.14:47: and whoever sleeps in the house shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening; and whoever eats in the house shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.14:48: But if the priest comes and enters and looks, and behold, the plague does not spread at all in the house after the house has been plastered, then the priest shall cleanse the house, because the plague has been healed.
verses.14:49: And to purify the house he shall take two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and spun scarlet, and hyssop;
verses.14:50: and he shall slay the one bird into an earthen vessel over living water,
verses.14:51: and he shall take the cedar wood, and the spun scarlet, and the hyssop, and the living bird, and dip it into the blood of the bird that was slain over living water, and sprinkle with them upon the house seven times.
verses.14:52: And he shall purify the house with the blood of the bird, and with the living water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the spun scarlet;
verses.14:53: and he shall send away the living bird outside the city into the open field; and he shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
verses.14:54: This is the law concerning every plague of leprosy and of scale,
verses.14:55: and of the leprosy of a garment and of a house,
verses.14:56: and of a scar, and of a mark, and of a bright spot,
verses.14:57: and to declare on what day a thing is unclean, and on what day it shall be cleansed. This is the law of leprosy."
verses.15:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.15:2: "Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to them: 'When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
verses.15:3: And this is the law of his uncleanness: when he flows with an issue from his body, from the discharge by which his body is stopped up through the discharge, this is his uncleanness in him; all the days of the discharge of his body, by which his body is stopped up through the discharge, it is his uncleanness.
verses.15:4: Every bed on which he who has a discharge lies is unclean, and every object on which he who has a discharge sits shall be unclean.
verses.15:5: And anyone who touches his bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:6: And he who sits on the object on which he who has a discharge sat shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:7: And he who touches the flesh of him who has a discharge shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:8: And if he who has a discharge spits on one who is clean, he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:9: And every saddle of a donkey on which he who has a discharge rides shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:10: And everyone who touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until evening; and he who carries those things shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:11: And everyone whom he who has a discharge touches, when he has not rinsed his hands, shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:12: And an earthen vessel which he who has a discharge touches shall be broken; and a wooden vessel shall be rinsed with water, and it shall be clean.
verses.15:13: And if he who has a discharge is cleansed from his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.15:14: And on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them before the Lord to the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, and give them to the priest.
verses.15:15: And the priest shall offer them, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord because of his discharge.
verses.15:16: And if a man has an emission of seed go out from him, then he shall bathe all his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:17: And every garment and every skin on which there is an emission of seed shall be washed with water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:18: And as for a woman, if a man lies with her with an emission of seed, they shall bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:19: And if a woman has a flow of blood, and her discharge is in her body, she shall be seven days in her separation; and everyone who touches her shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:20: And everything on which she lies during her separation shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
verses.15:21: And everyone who touches her bed shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:22: And everyone who touches any object on which she sat shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:23: And if, while she is on her bed or on the object on which she sits, he touches her, he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:24: And if anyone indeed lies with her, and her uncleanness comes upon him, then he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
verses.15:25: And if a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time of her separation, or if it flows beyond her separation, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as the days of separation; she shall be unclean.
verses.15:26: And every bed on which she lies all the days of the discharge shall be to her as the bed of separation, and every object on which she sits shall be unclean, according to the uncleanness of separation.
verses.15:27: Everyone who touches her shall be unclean, and shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:28: And if she is cleansed from the discharge, then she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be cleansed.
verses.15:29: And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.15:30: And the priest shall offer the one as a sin offering and the one as a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord because of the discharge of her uncleanness.'
verses.15:31: And you shall make the children of Israel cautious of their uncleannesses, and they shall not die because of their uncleanness, when they defile My tabernacle that is among them."
verses.15:32: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of anyone from whom an emission of seed goes out so that he is defiled by it,
verses.15:33: and of her who has a flow of blood in her separation, and of the one who has a discharge in his discharge, for the male or for the female, and for the man who lies with a woman who is in separation.
verses.16:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered strange fire before the Lord and died;
verses.16:2: and the Lord said to Moses, "Speak to Aaron your brother, and let him not enter at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is upon the ark of the testimony, and he shall not die; for I will appear in a cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.16:3: Thus Aaron shall enter into the holy place: with a calf from the herd as a sin offering, and a ram as a burnt offering.
verses.16:4: And he shall put on a consecrated linen tunic, and linen trousers shall be upon his flesh; and he shall be girded with a linen sash, and shall wear a linen turban. These are holy garments, and he shall bathe all his body in water and put them on.
verses.16:5: And from the congregation of the children of Israel he shall take two kids of the goats as a sin offering, and one ram as a burnt offering.
verses.16:6: And Aaron shall present the calf for his sin offering, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
verses.16:7: And he shall take the two goats and set them before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.16:8: And Aaron shall place upon the two goats one lot for the Lord and one lot for the scapegoat.
verses.16:9: And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot for the Lord fell, and offer it as a sin offering.
verses.16:10: But the goat on which the lot of the scapegoat fell he shall set alive before the Lord, to make atonement over it, so as to send it away for dismissal; he shall release it into the wilderness.
verses.16:11: And Aaron shall present the calf for the sin offering which is for himself and for his house alone, and make atonement for himself and for his house, and he shall slaughter the calf for the sin offering which is for himself.
verses.16:12: And he shall take the censer full of burning coals of fire from the altar that is before the Lord, and fill his hands with finely compounded incense, and bring it within the veil.
verses.16:13: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, and the vapor of the incense shall cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimonies, and he shall not die.
verses.16:14: And he shall take some of the blood of the calf and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat on the east side; and in front of the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood seven times with his finger.
verses.16:15: And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering which is for the people before the Lord, and bring some of its blood within the veil, and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the calf, and sprinkle its blood upon the mercy seat, in front of the mercy seat.
verses.16:16: And he shall make atonement for the holy place because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their wrongdoings concerning all their sins; and so he shall do for the tabernacle of testimony which is established among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.16:17: And no person shall be in the tabernacle of testimony when he enters to make atonement in the holy place, until he comes out; and he shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and for all the congregation of the children of Israel.
